verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say the CLI runs the entire Supabase stack locally or in a CI environment, and the MCP docs cover CI use with a personal access token passed as a header, plus guardrails for unattended routines. Advisors are also reachable from the CLI and Management API, and a community user confirms `supabase start` spins up Docker from migration files, though another reports difficulty getting local dev working. Missing for 10: concrete CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow), documented non-interactive CLI authentication for hosted projects, consistently positive hands-on corroboration of the headless/local stack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Supabase CLI enables you to run the entire Supabase stack locally, on your machine or in a CI environment.
you can create a personal access token (PAT) with the necessary scopes and pass it as a header to the MCP server
CLI (`supabase db advisors`), Management API (security advisors and performance advisors)
connect your repository and changes pushed to `main` are automatically deployed to your project.
